spine: 1. 2026-07-25：Ramana Kumar 發布一份 AI 協助產出、聲稱推翻 Collatz 猜想的 Lean 4 證明，實際上是利用一個尚未被發現的 kernel bug。
2. 2026-07-28：Kiran Gopinathan 把 exploit 縮成一個不需要任何 axiom 的 False 證明，開 issue #14576，標題直指 kernel 接受了結構不符的 projection。
3. 同一天，Lean 團隊在回報後一小時內推出修補 PR #14577，由 Joachim Breitner 審過並改進後合併。
4. 根因：kernel 消去形如 `I Ds is` 的 nested inductive occurrence 時，如果外層型別的參數 Ds 是 phantom（不出現在建構子欄位裡），這些參數會從產生的輔助型別中消失，因而繞過型別檢查。
5. 這個漏洞只能透過 metaprogramming 直接把 inductive 宣告送進 kernel 才能觸發——一般 frontend／elaborator 路徑會先檢查參數、擋下型別錯誤的項。
6. 事發前一週，Jeremy Chen 已經在獨立的 Rust 版 kernel nanoda 中回報並修好一個不相關的 bug；Joachim Breitner 提出假設，認為這次時間點的巧合來自「有能力找到這種 bug 的強模型」開始出現。

7. 修補之後，PR #14582 進一步收緊 nested occurrence 參數檢查，Daniel Selsam 與 AI security 研究者合作又抓出六個以上的 bug（全部先被 nanoda 抓到），另有三個 PR 強化 kernel invariant，comparator.live 也改為預設跑 nanoda 並每日追蹤；de Moura 強調這是 implementation bug 而非 meta-theory 漏洞，並反對因此限制 metaprogramming，因為 elaborator 本來就是不被信任的元件。

perspective.mechanism: kernel 消去 nested inductive occurrence（`I Ds is`）時會產生一個輔助型別（auxiliary type）把巢狀部分攤平；如果外層參數是 phantom（不出現在建構子欄位），這個攤平步驟會把該參數弄丟，導致它逃過後續型別檢查——這只能透過 metaprogramming 直接把 inductive 宣告送進 kernel 才能觸發，正常的 elaborator 路徑會先擋下。
perspective.tradeoff: de Moura 明確拒絕「限制 metaprogramming」作為修法：elaborator 本來就是不被信任的元件，soundness 不能建立在「不被信任的元件拒絕產生壞項」之上，因為攻擊者一樣可以直接寫 `.olean` 檔或改記憶體繞過 elaborator；kernel 與 elaborator 的權責分離正是 proof term 架構的優點，而不是需要收緊的漏洞。
perspective.reader_use: 任何使用 proof assistant 或依賴形式化驗證鏈的工程師，這次事件的可操作訊號是：kernel 的信任邊界要靠獨立實作互相校驗撐住（nanoda 這類第二顆 kernel），而不是靠限制前端功能；comparator.live 現在把 nanoda 設為預設項，是可以直接沿用的模式。

perspective.mechanism: issue 標題本身就是症狀描述：kernel 接受了一個「投影（projection）的結構名稱與被投影的值不符」的已檢查宣告，並提供了完整的 `Bug.lean` 檔案重現，最終得到 `theorem boom : False := nomatch (bad : T false)`，`#print axioms` 顯示不依賴任何 axiom。
perspective.tradeoff: 把 bug 縮到最小重現（minimal proof of False）而不是留著原本複雜的 Collatz exploit，讓修補方能快速定位到「kernel 錯誤接受不符結構的 projection」這一個具體斷言，而不必先看懂整套 Collatz 反證的偽裝。
perspective.reader_use: 遇到形式化驗證系統回報的 soundness 問題時，先把 exploit 縮到「不依賴任何前提、直接證明 False」的最小重現，比保留完整攻擊情境更快讓維護者定位根因。

perspective.mechanism: PR 說明直接對應根因：處理形如 `I Ds is` 的 nested occurrence 時，參數 Ds 在產生輔助型別（auxiliary type generation）的過程中被省略，因而逃過型別驗證；修法是在這些 inductive type 在環境中可用之後，補上對這些參數的型別檢查。
perspective.tradeoff: 修補由回報 issue 的原作者 leodemoura 直接送出、Joachim Breitner（nomeata）審查並改進後合併，兩者身分本身帶著權威性但也代表這次修補走的是「作者本人主導、快速合併」而非走完整外部審查流程——事後才靠一連串 follow-up PR 補上更嚴謹的驗證。
perspective.reader_use: 一個 kernel 級別的 soundness 修補，可以先用最小的針對性 patch 在一小時內止血，事後再用一系列獨立 PR 補齊 regression test 與更嚴格的 invariant——不需要等到「完美修法」才能合併第一版。

notes.quote: On July 25, Ramana Kumar published a repository containing a `sorry`-free "disproof" of the Collatz conjecture, produced with AI assistance. It is not a valid proof because it exploits a bug in the kernel's handling of nested inductive types.
notes.interpretation: postmortem 作者直接陳述這是利用 kernel bug 的展示，不是真的數學反證。

notes.quote: On July 28, Kiran Gopinathan reduced it to a small proof of False and opened issue #14576.
notes.interpretation: 同一天完成從完整 exploit 到最小 False 證明的化簡並開 issue。

notes.quote: We pushed a fix one hour after the report (#14577). Joachim Breitner reviewed it and suggested improvements, and it was merged.
notes.interpretation: 修補在回報後一小時內推出，並經 Joachim Breitner 審過、改進後合併。

notes.quote: when the kernel eliminates a nested occurrence under an inductive type `T` with parameters `Ds`, and these parameters are phantom (not mentioned in constructor fields), they disappear from the generated auxiliary type and thus escape type checking.
notes.interpretation: 這是根因的技術描述：nested occurrence 消去時，phantom 參數從輔助型別上消失。

notes.quote: This is an implementation bug, not a hole in Lean's meta-theory.
notes.interpretation: de Moura 明確定性：這是實作層級的錯誤，不是理論基礎的漏洞。

notes.quote: only reachable through metaprogramming, by sending the inductive declaration to the kernel directly. The frontend checks the arguments and catches the ill-typed term.
notes.interpretation: 正常路徑（frontend/elaborator）會擋下這個問題，只有直接把宣告送進 kernel 的 metaprogramming 路徑能觸發。

notes.quote: The nanoda bug was reported by Jeremy Chen and fixed a week before the Lean bug was reported.
notes.interpretation: nanoda（獨立的 Rust 版 kernel）在事發前一週已經修好一個不相關的 bug。

notes.quote: the official kernel had "a missing check in the nested inductive type support," while nanoda "did not verify the type name in a projection node." Both bugs were fixed by their respective discovery dates, but the exploit was constructed to pass the old nanoda version.
notes.interpretation: 兩個各自獨立的 bug 在時間上交會：官方 kernel 缺一個 nested inductive 的檢查，nanoda 沒有驗證 projection 節點的型別名稱；exploit 是針對舊版 nanoda 建構的。

notes.quote: Joachim proposed the hypothesis that the timing coincidence is due to the availability of strong models able to find this bug.
notes.interpretation: 這是 Joachim Breitner 提出的假設，用來解釋為何兩個獨立 bug 的發現時間點會如此接近，並非已證實的結論。

notes.quote: Tests added to the Kernel Arena for the exploit and "a related non-uniform-parameter case raised by Arthur Adjedj."
notes.interpretation: 回歸測試涵蓋這次 exploit 以及 Arthur Adjedj 提出的一個相關 non-uniform-parameter case。

notes.quote: makes the kernel check that the parameters of a nested occurrence actually behave as parameters, rather than only re-type-checking them.
notes.interpretation: PR #14582 進一步要求 kernel 確認 nested occurrence 的參數真的表現得像參數，而不只是重新型別檢查一次。

notes.quote: Daniel Selsam at OpenAI assisted the Lean FRO with an AI specialized in cybersecurity, and found other programming mistakes in the Lean kernel. All of them have been fixed. All of them were caught by nanoda. PRs: #14607, #14608, #14609, #14613, #14615, #14616.
notes.interpretation: Daniel Selsam 與 AI security 專家合作找出更多程式錯誤，全部修好，且全部先被 nanoda 抓到，對應六個 PR 編號。

notes.quote: We have also hardened kernel invariants. PRs: #14621, #14631, #14632.
notes.interpretation: 另有三個 PR 專門強化 kernel invariant。

notes.quote: comparator.live now runs nanoda by default, and nanoda is tracked daily so lean-eval and comparator stay current after upstream fixes.
notes.interpretation: comparator.live 這個工具現在把 nanoda 設為預設檢查器，並每天追蹤 nanoda 版本以保持同步。

notes.quote: The team is "reaching out to and supporting experts who can find further bugs, develop new kernels, and work on the theory or on verified kernels."
notes.interpretation: Lean 團隊表態要主動接觸、支持能找更多 bug、開發新 kernel 或做理論/verified kernel 研究的專家。

notes.quote: The elaborator is untrusted by design. Soundness cannot depend on an untrusted component refusing to build a bad term.
notes.interpretation: de Moura 反對「限制 metaprogramming」作為修法方向的核心論點：elaborator 本來就不被信任，soundness 不能靠它自我約束。

notes.quote: attackers can also write `.olean` files directly or modify memory, both of which bypass the elaborator entirely.
notes.interpretation: 限制 elaborator 也擋不住直接寫 .olean 檔或改記憶體的攻擊路徑，所以真正的防線只能是 kernel 本身。

notes.quote: This separation and isolation of concerns is one of the main advantages of proof terms.
notes.interpretation: kernel 與 elaborator 的權責分離被 de Moura 定性為 proof term 架構的優點而非缺陷。

notes.quote: Kernel accepts wrong-structure projections, allowing an axiom-free proof of False
notes.interpretation: issue 標題本身就是症狀描述：kernel 接受了結構不符的 projection。

notes.quote: Lean accepts a checked declaration containing a projection whose structure name does not match the value being projected.
notes.interpretation: issue 描述的具體症狀：一個已檢查宣告裡的 projection，其結構名稱跟被投影的值對不上。

notes.quote: theorem boom : False := nomatch (bad : T false)
notes.interpretation: issue 裡給出的最小重現，`#print axioms` 顯示不依賴任何 axiom。

notes.quote: kiranandcode
notes.interpretation: issue 的回報者帳號，對應 Kiran Gopinathan。

notes.quote: fix: missing check at kernel inductive declaration
notes.interpretation: 修補 PR 的標題。

notes.quote: When eliminating a nested occurrence `I Ds is`, the parametric arguments `Ds` are dropped from the generated auxiliary types, so they used to escape type checking. We now type check them once the inductive types being declared are available.
notes.interpretation: PR 說明對根因與修法的具體描述：Ds 在輔助型別生成時被省略，修法是等 inductive type 在環境中可用後補上型別檢查。

notes.quote: Author: leodemoura; Reviewer: nomeata (Joachim Breitner); Closes #14576
notes.interpretation: PR 由 leodemoura 送出，nomeata（即 Joachim Breitner）審查，關閉 issue #14576。

notes.quote: I am grateful to Joachim Breitner and Sebastian Ullrich for their revisions and suggestions on this post.
notes.interpretation: postmortem 列出的關鍵人物之一，負責校閱這篇文章。

notes.quote: Mario Carneiro's lean4lean is a Lean formalization of Lean's type theory together with a proof that the kernel implements it.
notes.interpretation: postmortem 列出的關鍵人物之一，Mario Carneiro 建立了 lean4lean，用 Lean 自己形式化了 Lean 的型別理論。

notes.quote: nanoda is an independent kernel (aka proof/type checker) for Lean implemented in Rust by Chris Bailey.
notes.interpretation: postmortem 列出的關鍵人物之一，Chris Bailey 是 nanoda（獨立的 Rust 版 kernel 檢查器）的實作者。

notes.quote: Daniel Selsam at OpenAI assisted the Lean FRO with an AI specialized in cybersecurity, and found other programming mistakes in the Lean kernel.
notes.interpretation: postmortem 把 Daniel Selsam 列為 OpenAI 的關鍵人物之一，他協助 Lean FRO 找 AI cybersecurity 專家合作抓更多 kernel bug。

notes.quote: src/kernel/inductive.cpp
notes.interpretation: PR #14577 的 files changed 清單裡，唯一的產品程式碼變更是 src/kernel/inductive.cpp，其餘兩個檔案在 tests/elab/ 之下。

claims.claim_text: 2026 年 7 月 25 日 Ramana Kumar 發布 AI 協助寫成、聲稱推翻 Collatz 猜想的 Lean 4 證明。
claims.evidence: On July 25, Ramana Kumar published a repository containing a `sorry`-free "disproof" of the Collatz conjecture, produced with AI assistance.
claims.note: Date, name, AI assistance and kernel-bug exploitation all present.

claims.claim_text: 三天後 Kiran Gopinathan 縮成一段不依賴任何 axiom 的 False 證明。
claims.evidence: On July 28, Kiran Gopinathan reduced it to a small proof of False and opened issue #14576.
claims.note: 7/25 to 7/28 is exactly three days. The axiom-free part is corroborated independently by the issue title and #print axioms output.

claims.claim_text: postmortem 說得很直接：這份 repository 是「produced with AI assistance」，而且「It is not a valid proof because it exploits a bug in the kernel's handling of nested inductive types.」
claims.evidence: produced with AI assistance ... It is not a valid proof because it exploits a bug in the kernel's handling of nested inductive types.
claims.note: Round 1 caught a SYNTHESIZED quote: the post rendered 「an AI-assisted "disproof" of the Collatz conjecture exploiting the kernel bug」 inside quotation marks, a string that does not exist on the page — the source splits it across two sentences. n01's quote field was itself a WebFetch summary span. Both the note and the prose were corrected to the source's actual wording.

claims.claim_text: issue #14576 標題「Kernel accepts wrong-structure projections, allowing an axiom-free proof of False」
claims.evidence: Kernel accepts wrong-structure projections, allowing an axiom-free proof of False
claims.note: Verbatim.

claims.claim_text: theorem boom : False := nomatch (bad : T false)，#print axioms 顯示不依賴任何 axiom
claims.evidence: theorem boom : False := nomatch (bad : T false) | 'boom' does not depend on any axioms
claims.note: Verbatim from the issue's Bug.lean and Actual behavior block.

claims.claim_text: 根因引語（phantom 參數從輔助型別上消失）
claims.evidence: when the kernel eliminates a nested occurrence under an inductive type `T` with parameters `Ds`, and these parameters are phantom (not mentioned in constructor fields), they disappear from the generated auxiliary type and thus escape type checking.
claims.note: Verbatim; the post drops only the source's leading 'The bug:' label.

claims.claim_text: PR #14577 說明：「When eliminating a nested occurrence `I Ds is`, the parametric arguments `Ds` are dropped from the generated auxiliary types, so they used to escape type checking.」
claims.evidence: When eliminating a nested occurrence `I Ds is`, the parametric arguments `Ds` are dropped from the generated auxiliary types, so they used to escape type checking.
claims.note: Round 1 caught a second SYNTHESIZED quote: the post had 'When processing nested occurrences ... were omitted from auxiliary type generation ... escape type validation', none of which is the PR's wording. n24's quote field was a WebFetch rewrite. Both note and prose replaced with the PR's actual text.

claims.claim_text: issue 內文症狀句「Lean accepts a checked declaration containing a projection whose structure name does not match the value being projected.」
claims.evidence: Lean accepts a checked declaration containing a projection whose structure name does not match the value being projected.
claims.note: Verbatim. Minor: it is the issue's first body sentence rather than its title; the post's referring phrase is slightly loose but the fact is unaffected.

claims.claim_text: 「only reachable through metaprogramming, by sending the inductive declaration to the kernel directly. The frontend checks the arguments and catches the ill-typed term.」
claims.evidence: The bug is only reachable through metaprogramming, by sending the inductive declaration to the kernel directly. The frontend checks the arguments and catches the ill-typed term.
claims.note: Verbatim substring; the post supplies a Chinese subject in place of the dropped 'The bug is'.

claims.claim_text: PR #14577 標題、作者 leodemoura、審查者 nomeata、關閉 #14576
claims.evidence: fix: missing check at kernel inductive declaration | Author: leodemoura | Reviewer: nomeata | Closes #14576
claims.note: Corroborated by both the PR page and the postmortem.

claims.claim_text: 從 issue 開出到修補，postmortem 給出的時間是一小時。
claims.evidence: We pushed a fix one hour after the report (#14577). Joachim Breitner reviewed it and suggested improvements, and it was merged.
claims.note: Round 1: the post read 'pushed' as 'merged' and twice asserted 「一小時內合併」; the source times only the push, with review and merge following. Corrected in prose and in the timeline widget's node-3 state text.

claims.claim_text: 這起事件從公開展示到修補合併，前後三天。
claims.evidence: On July 25, Ramana Kumar published a repository ... On July 28 ... it was merged.
claims.note: Round 1: the post said 「不到三天」, which both overstated the source (it gives calendar dates only, no times) and contradicted the opener's own 「三天後」. Corrected to 三天.

claims.claim_text: nanoda 在 issue 開出前一週已修好一個不相關的 bug（Jeremy Chen 回報）。
claims.evidence: The nanoda bug was reported by Jeremy Chen and fixed a week before the Lean bug was reported.
claims.note: Name, one-week gap and bug content all match.

claims.evidence: The surprising part is that there are two unrelated bugs involved ... nanoda did check that spot, but did not verify the type name in a projection node.
claims.note: A neutral restatement of the source's two-unrelated-bugs passage.

claims.evidence: Regression tests for the exploit, and for a related non-uniform-parameter case raised by Arthur Adjedj, are in the Kernel Arena.
claims.note: Name, case type and Kernel Arena all match.

claims.evidence: Daniel Selsam at OpenAI assisted the Lean FRO with an AI specialized in cybersecurity, and found other programming mistakes in the Lean kernel.
